gistemp_v4.licence: NOT STATED on the pages read. The GISTEMP page asks for citation and states that graphics created with its tools need no permission but should credit NASA GISS; it makes no statement about redistributing the data table.
gistemp_v4.licence_quote: Graphics from these GISTEMP pages are subject to NASA Image and Media guidance. ... graphics you may create using the website tools here do not require permission for you to use elsewhere, but acknowledgment of their source should be given.
gistemp_v4.redistribution: NO values published. Used only to compute the size of the difference to HadCRUT5 (recorded in this file under crosscheck).
gistemp_v4.citation: GISTEMP Team, 2026: GISS Surface Temperature Analysis (GISTEMP), version 4. NASA Goddard Institute for Space Studies. crosscheck.reading: Both series re-based to their own 1880-1900 mean; difference = GISTEMP minus HadCRUT5, annual J-D. Cross-check only; no GISTEMP value is published on the site.
